title: Other New York statutory departures from consideration requirements
summary: The supplement also reproduces provisions concerning written assignments, published rewards, and promises in certain conveyances.
notes:
Section 5-1107 addresses the effect of a written assignment signed by the assignor or agent. Section 5-1113 addresses written or published promises of a reward for return of lost or mislaid property. Section 5-1115 addresses a grantor’s promise or warranty in a qualifying acknowledged or proved real-property conveyance where no consideration was intended.

These provisions illustrate why statutory scope matters. Their distinct subjects and formal requirements should be examined separately; they do not replace all consideration rules with a universal requirement of a writing.
